b2.rags_tribe_takes_armor_dungeon.summary: Rags' tribe defeats an animated, enchanted suit of armor guarding a mountain dungeon entrance, using crossbows and explosive boom-bark, without losing a single goblin.

canon_ref.note: Rags reasons "the dead speak all tongues".

b2.toren_and_rags_learn_to_sign.summary: Rags discovers Toren can understand goblin speech, and the two work out a rough sign system between a mute skeleton and a goblin.

b2.rags_tribe_dungeon_trap_kills_six.summary: Exploring a golem-guarded corridor deeper in, a trap kills six of Rags' goblins; the survivors flee with a cursed pendant that melts a bat that tries to wear it.

b2.rags_tribe_seals_mountain_lair.summary: Rags has the tribe wall off the dangerous corridor with rubble and settles her tribe at the dungeon's entrance rather than push further in.

b2.relc_beats_rags_at_the_inn.news: Watch Sergeant Relc beat the Goblin Rags in the yard of the Wandering Inn and swore to kill her tribe on sight, until innkeeper Erin Solstice stepped between them.

canon_ref.note: Over the chess incident; a Frost Faerie chases Relc off in exchange for a favor (paid back in 2.20/2.21).

b2.relc_beats_rags_at_the_inn.summary: Relc corners Rags at the inn over the chess incident, beats her, and threatens her whole tribe. Erin steps between them, and a Frost Faerie drives Relc off in return for a favor.

b2.rags_ambushes_jawbreaker_chief.news: Word from the north: the goblin Rags has moved her tribe again and taken over the small Jawbreaker Tribe.
b2.rags_ambushes_jawbreaker_chief.summary: Rather than risk the Watch or the Red Fang, Rags decides to move her tribe north and swallow the small Jawbreaker Tribe, ambushing and killing its Hob chief, Rockgaw.
